changelog:
A dropped stream comes back, every time — and a phone call or a turn of the phone no longer breaks it.

WHAT CHANGED

- Recovery no longer gives up after the first drop of a session. It
  now waits a little longer between each retry (1, 2, 4, 8, then 16
  seconds), so a provider that is down for a few seconds is ridden out
  instead of exhausting every attempt at once.
- Switching between Wi-Fi and mobile data reconnects the stream straight
  away, instead of sitting on a frozen picture for about 15 seconds.
- A phone call no longer looks like a frozen stream, so the player
  stops trying to reconnect while you are talking.
- Turning the phone while a channel is starting no longer makes that
  first stream buffer badly. Turning it while a channel plays never
  restarts it.
- A live channel that has fallen 15 seconds or more behind now shows a
  LIVE button that takes you straight back to now.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything else, including 0.3.3.18's nine-digit TV pairing and the
  update check on every start.
